rationale: The agent did not follow key policy steps. Although it looked up the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details), it proceeded to perform write actions without explicit customer confirmation: it executed an exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) and a return (return_delivered_order_items) directly. The user asked to see all shorter bamboo skateboard options and their prices and to pick the most expensive; the agent only retrieved a single product’s details and did not present options or prices, nor confirm the selection. For the garden hose, the user wanted an exchange to match the pending type, but the agent performed a return instead, again without confirmation or evidence it matched the pending order. There is no final confirmation or clear outcomes provided. These constitute violations of the confirmation and request-fulfillment requirements, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
